content.s1_any_run: On 1000 <= t, 1/200 <= d0 < 1/2, any N with 0 < N: from the bridge (fill(N) = ||p4_em_expr sL N||) and the pin (wallLo(N) > ||poff t d0 t||): fill(N) >= wallLo(N) [t4LE_floor_off] > ||poff|| = floStripMin [t4LE_flo_eq_own] > BwireR + MrR [FUnif.s4StripUnifiedFloor with MfR = 0] - so the face premise (fill(N) <= BwireR + MrR) is false; the pin and face premises of any squeeze instance are jointly impossible in body at that run.
content.s2_class_exhausted: Every squeeze instance is a choice of run N with premises {A2c bridge at N, S3 face at N, pin at N}. By S1 the set is inconsistent in body for EVERY N (given its own pin+bridge premises the face is negated). Hence the EM-squeeze class - all named and un-named instantiations - cannot discharge hOffCPT2 on its in-band domain [1/200, 1/2) at target height. The 0252/0253 single-C S1 failure and the 0260/0261 Noff exhaustion are both special views of this one in-body fact (0252/0253: the pin fails at the schedule run; 0260/0261: at Noff the face fails, by the same chain with the in-body 0259 pin).
content.s3_residue_narrowed: What remains for hOffCPT2 on [1/200, fractionContactD0max]: (route a) a zeta-data-class record - the squeeze needs a face (fill below wire), and on the far band the fill's EM-kernel side sits above the wire wherever the pin holds, so only certified data bounding the TRUE fill (not the EM kernel) could supply a face - the B24/B25 exact-rational board conveyor under the B6 watcher is that data path (frontier extension re-labels the face, B25 fires one-shot on the first merged record below anchor; board idle at the TEN family contact as of 0261/0262); (route b) a genuinely new argument outside the {pin + bridge + face} structure (e.g. a direct zero-side bound that does not route through the EM truncation machinery); (domain note) on the near band (0 < d0 < 1/200) the squeeze theorems are out of their in-band domain and contribute nothing in body - the T4OffLH measured map (0261) characterizes the Q2 mechanism there (no tension on (0, 1e-3] in body; seams measured; tension onset ~4.74e-3 t-uniform). hOffCPT2 stays open; the endpoint stays conditional on {hzF, hPT2, hOffCPT2}.
